text:
morgan: Heads-up — we plan to run the profiles.user_index ADD + backfill at 02:00 UTC tonight. This touches a hot read path so we need surge protection and clear rollback criteria. @kevin @jen can you confirm ops guards?
kevin: ack. I can pin deploybot to the migration release and set a global ratecap. What are the hard abort signals?
morgan: proposed aborts: 1) any table lock > 5s seen by lockwatch, 2) p95 read latency for profiles API > 200ms for 3 consecutive 1-min windows, 3) replica lag > 10s during backfill. Also plan canary to 10% tenants first.
jen: ok. add one more: if error rate for profile reads > 1% we pause. I'll add a feature-flag kill-switch and the rollback playbook.
raj: I'll watch the backfill job pool. Setting per-tenant concurrency to 4 and global qps to 200. If queue growth > 20% over baseline for 3 mins we throttle to 50 qps.
kevin: deploybot pin command ready:
```
# pin deploybot to release v2023.11-mig
deploybot pin release v2023.11-mig --scope migration-jobs --until 03:00UTC
```
kevin: also setting ratecap: `rbctl set-ratecap backfill 200`
morgan: good. canary list: tenant IDs sampled -> 101, 204, 305, 412. After 10m stable we expand to 50%.
deploybot: Deploybot: canary rollout initiated for 1734569000. Stage: canary-10pct. Rolling out migration job image v2023.11-mig.
opsbot: opsbot: monitoring alert rule `profiles_backfill_lockwatch` created: lock >5s -> page oncall.
jen: quick SQL snippet for offline backfill (for runbook):
```
BEGIN;
ALTER TABLE profiles ADD COLUMN user_index text;
-- backfill iterating in batches
UPDATE profiles SET user_index = compute_idx(profile_data) WHERE user_index IS NULL LIMIT 5000;
COMMIT;
```
morgan: note — do NOT run full-table update in one transaction. Use batching and sleep jitter.
raj: if we see replica lag spike during batch N, we abort and resume from last processed id after 30m cool-down. I've added a checkpoint marker to the job.
kevin: thumbs-up :thumbsup: I'll post release notes snippet to #release-notes after canary passes. Also leaving manual rollback steps in runbook.
morgan: final checklist before 02:00: pin deploybot (done), ratecap set (done), feature flag + kill-switch (jen done), oncall aware (opsbot paging), sampling list frozen (morgan done). If everyone agrees we go at :00.
jen: agree. I'll be on call at 02:00-03:30.
kevin: +1.
raj: +1.
morgan: starting rollout in 5. updating thread with progress.
deploybot: Deploybot: canary step complete — 10% tenants migrated. No lock alarms. 10m monitoring window starts now.
kevin: monitoring shows p95 120ms, errors 0.2%, replica lag 1s. all good.
morgan: expanding to 50% now.
deploybot: Deploybot: expanded to 50%. Backfill rate at configured 200 qps.
opsbot: opsbot: alert `profiles_backfill_lockwatch` fired for shard 305: lock 6.2s. Paging oncall.
jen: @kevin I'm seeing lock alert, rolling back expansion — pausing job pool and shrinking to 10%. Triggering rollback playbook now.
kevin: executing rollback: `deploybot rollback release v2023.11-mig --to stable`
deploybot: Deploybot: rollback initiated. Migration jobs paused. Checkpoint saved at last id 782344.
raj: pausing confirmed. Will resume only after post-mortem and adjustments to batch size.
morgan: thanks team. Post-mortem TBD; immediate action items: reduce batch size to 250, add longer inter-batch jitter, and add lock contention metric to canary gate. I'll create ticket.
